findings.evidence: patch.diff 原文：#define SIPHASH_FUNC(name, rotl, load64, in_byte) 与 4 处 SIPHASH_FUNC 实例化（siphash_base/siphash_zbb/siphash_nocase_base/siphash_nocase_zbb）
